digest.component_or_area: metrics/blame.py — caused_by derivation and commit-history scanning
propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits 'Ambiguous prefix' errors to stderr when commit subjects contain bare 4-hex fragments that match multiple tickets, even though the close itself commits durably and the errors are spurious.

The post-close _find_fixing_commit scan re-resolves the bug_id on every commit in the branch history without memoization or quiet-resolution, resulting in an O(commits × tickets) alias scan that keeps the CLI hanging for minutes after the close completes.

The blame.py module lacks quiet-mode resolution at scanner call sites (_resolves_to, _commit_ticket, derive_caused_by) and does not validate that hex-quad candidate refs are prefixes of the target before invoking the resolver, causing unnecessary filesystem work on unrelated commit subjects.

Documentation (AGENTS.md and _ids.py module docstring) advertises bare 4-digit (single-quad) hex references as a supported form, conflating them with proper 8-digit two-quad prefixes and contributing to operator confusion about resolution semantics.
The derived bug-id and commit-subject resolution paths are loop-invariant and candidate resolutions are recomputed per commit despite being identical across all commits in a branch history.
